spec.rule: RF04.2: at each cutoff record the exact training range, parameter schema, seed, trials, Mode 4 selection decomposition, selector/fallback status, selected digest and activation. Both arms share the fallback definition; a missing field is null plus a reason
spec.selector_fallback_rule: NOT_RECORDED: no per-cutoff selector fallback field exists in the committed RF-04 artifacts; the Mode 4 endpoint path selects among scored candidates and its trial ledger has no fallback flag. The fallback fraction is left null rather than reported as zero

fallback_fraction.reason: NOT_RECORDED: no per-cutoff selector fallback field exists in the committed RF-04 artifacts; the Mode 4 endpoint path selects among scored candidates and its trial ledger has no fallback flag. The fallback fraction is left null rather than reported as zero

model_design.fallback_fraction_note: the model-design fallback question is separate from the per-cutoff Mode 4 candidate selection; this field records which design the registry followed
